paragraphs: From Maple House in Rosemount Business Park, pull off and head to the end of the road
Take a right onto Ballycoolin Road at the mini roundabout, go slight left to stay on Ballycoolin Road and continue for around 800 metres up to the next rotary
At the rotary, keep slight left to join Blanchardstown Road North and follow it through the next rotary as well, staying left both times
After about 600 metres, take a right onto Buzzardstown Road, then at the small roundabout take a right into Warrenstown Green
Take the 1st right into Warrenstown Row, then at the end of the road turn left into Warrenstown Grove
You will be asked to pull in on the left for a controlled stop or reverse practice, then carry out a turnabout (three point turn) to face back the way you came
Retrace your route: right out of Warrenstown Grove, right into Warrenstown Row, left onto Warrenstown Green
Right at the roundabout onto Buzzardstown Road and straight through the next roundabout
Continue along Buzzardstown Road take the right at the roundabout onto Church Road
Turn right into Dromheath Avenue and left into Dromheath Crescent for another pull in and turnabout exercise
Come back out, left onto Dromheath Avenue, and follow it to the end of the road where you turn right onto Church Road
Follow Church Road all the way to the Damastown Roundabout
At Damastown take the rotary and go straight ahead onto Cruiserath Road, following it for about a kilometre back to the Ballycoolin Road rotary
Keep slight left through the rotary and mini roundabout to stay on Ballycoolin Road
Take the left back into Rosemount Business Park and return to Maple House to finish the route
